# Packages whose locked versions are refreshed every week.
# Only list packages that carry CVE fixes: everything here moves the shipped
# image venv, so a bad entry fails the Smoke Test rather than the review.
pillow
urllib3
certifi
aiohttp
filelock
dnspython
# fsspec is left out on purpose. CVE-2026-104851 is fixed in fsspec 2026.6.0,
# but datasets 3.3.2 caps fsspec at 2024.12.0, and moving to datasets 5 pulls
# pyarrow>=21, which requires numpy 2, which caikit-nlp 0.5.14 forbids. The
# image installs fsspec over the resolved venv instead (Dockerfile.konflux).
